package.description: 在 cc-switch 之上通过 share id 组网实现 P2P 供应商共享的桌面应用。

en-US.description: A desktop app that shares AI CLI providers over a P2P network built on cc-switch.
en-US.longDescription:
cc-switch-remote is built on top of cc-switch (provider management and local routing) and adds share-id networking: multiple clients form a P2P network through a share id, routing requests from local CLIs such as Claude Code and Codex to other members' machines to consume the provider quota they share.
Requests are always issued by the lender's own machine against the upstream provider (an outbound-identity model), so the provider only ever sees the lender's machine and credentials, and the consumer's API key never leaves the consumer's machine. The desktop client connects to the official relay (tokentap.top) by default and works out of the box, while a self-hostable signaling/relay server is provided for advanced users.

zh-CN.description: 在 cc-switch 之上通过 share id 组网实现 P2P 供应商共享的桌面应用。
zh-CN.longDescription:
cc-switch-remote 基于 cc-switch（供应商管理与本地路由）二次开发，新增 share id 组网能力：多个客户端通过 share id 组成 P2P 网络，把本地 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 的请求路由到网络内其他成员的机器上，消费对方共享出来的供应商额度。
请求永远由出借方本机向上游服务商发出（出站身份模型），服务商全程只看到出借方的机器与凭据；消费方的 API Key 从不离开消费方本机。桌面客户端默认连接官方 relay（tokentap.top），无需自建服务端即可组网，也提供可自建的信令/中继服务器。
zh-CN.name: cc-switch-remote
